title: Quietly Baked Northern Irish Cheese Tagine
description: A cozy and herbal Northern Irish dish featuring a rich cheese pull, served with toasted bread and baked in a traditional tagine pot. This kosher-friendly recipe is perfect for a cold winter evening.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped onion and cook for 3 minutes, until softened.
Stir in the dried thyme and rosemary.
In a large bowl, combine the shredded cheddar and parmesan cheese.
Add the cooked garlic and onion mixture to the cheese and stir until well combined.
Transfer the cheese mixture to a traditional tagine pot.
Arrange the sliced bread around the edge of the tagine pot.
Cover the pot with a lid and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the lid and bake for an additional 10 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
